name: CreateVpnGateway

parameters.help_en: The region where the VPN gateway resides. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to query region IDs
parameters.help_zh: VPN网关所在的地域。您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID。
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the VPN gateway. Default value: the ID of the VPN gateway.

The name must be 2 to 100 characters in length, and cannot start with http:// or https://. It must start with a letter and can contain letters, digits, underscores (_), hyphens (-), and periods (.). Other special characters are not supported
parameters.help_zh:
VPN网关的名称，默认值为VPN网关的ID。

长度为2～100个字符，不能以`http://`或`https://`开头，需要以大写或小写字母开头，后面可包含大小写字母、数字、下划线（_）、短划线（-）和半角句号（.），不支持其他特殊字符
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the VPC-connected instance to which the VPN gateway belongs
parameters.name: vpc_id

parameters.example: 中国站示例值：PREPAY，国际站示例值：POSTPAY

The subscription duration. Unit: months. Valid values: 1 to 9, 12, 24, and 36.

This parameter is required when the InstanceChargeType parameter is set to PREPAY.</props>
parameters.help_zh:
购买时长。单位：月。取值：1~9、12、24或36。

<props="china">
InstanceChargeType参数的值为PREPAY时，该参数必选。</props>
parameters.name: period

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to automatically pay the bill for the VPN gateway. Valid values:

true: automatically pays the bill for the VPN gateway.

false (default): does not automatically pay the bill for the VPN gateway.

To ensure the successful creation of the VPN gateway instance, enable automatic payment. If automatic payment is disabled, you must manually pay the bill to create the VPN gateway instance
parameters.help_zh:
是否自动支付VPN网关的账单。取值：

true：自动支付VPN网关的账单。

false（默认值）：不自动支付VPN网关的账单。

为了成功创建VPN网关实例，建议您开启自动支付。如果您关闭了自动支付，则需要手动支付账单才能成功创建VPN网关实例
parameters.name: auto_pay

parameters.help_en:
The bandwidth limit of the VPN gateway. Unit: Mbit/s.

<props="china">- If you want to create an Internet-public VPN gateway, valid values are 5, 10, 20, 50, 100, 200, 500, and 1000.</props>
<props="china">- If you want to create an internal-public VPN gateway, valid values are 200 and 1000.</props>
<props="intl">- If you want to create an Internet-public VPN gateway, valid values are 10, 100, 200, 500, and 1000.</props>
<props="intl">- If you want to create an internal-public VPN gateway, valid values are 200 and 1000.</props>

In some regions, the maximum bandwidth limit supported by a VPN gateway is 500 Mbit/s. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/65290.html
parameters.help_zh:
VPN网关的带宽规格。单位：Mbps。

<props="china">- 如果您要创建公网VPN网关，则取值为：5、10、20、50、100、200、500或1000。</props>
<props="china">- 如果您要创建私网VPN网关，则取值为：200或1000。</props>
<props="intl">- 如果您要创建公网VPN网关，则取值为：10、100、200、500或1000。</props>
<props="intl">- 如果您要创建私网VPN网关，则取值为：200或1000。</props>

部分地域下VPN网关支持的最大带宽规格为500 Mbps。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/65290.html
parameters.name: bandwidth

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the IPsec-VPN feature. Valid values:

false: does not enable the IPsec-VPN feature
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启IPsec-VPN功能。取值：

true（默认值）：开启IPsec-VPN功能。

false：不开启IPsec-VPN功能
parameters.name: enable_ipsec

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the SSL-VPN feature. Valid values:

true: enables the SSL-VPN feature.

false (default): does not enable the SSL-VPN feature

是否开启SSL-VPN功能。取值：

false（默认值）：不开启SSL-VPN功能
parameters.name: enable_ssl

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of concurrent SSL-VPN connections. Valid values: 5 (default), 10, 20, 50, 100, 200, 500, and 1000
parameters.name: ssl_connections

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the vSwitch to which the VPN gateway is connected. 

In regions that support dual-tunnel IPsec-VPN connections, this parameter is required. You must specify a vSwitch and also specify the DisasterRecoveryVSwitchId parameter.
In regions that support single-tunnel IPsec-VPN connections, if you do not specify a vSwitch, the system automatically selects a vSwitch in the VPC
parameters.help_zh:
指定VPN网关实例关联的交换机实例。 

在支持创建双隧道模式IPsec-VPN连接的地域，本参数必填，您必须指定一个交换机实例，同时您还要指定DisasterRecoveryVSwitchId参数的值。
在支持创建单隧道模式IPsec-VPN连接的地域，如果您不指定交换机实例，系统将从VPC下自动选择一个交换机实例
parameters.name: vswitch_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the VPN gateway. Valid values:
Normal (default): standard VPN gateway.
<props="china">- NationalStandard: Chinese national standard VPN gateway.</props>
parameters.help_zh:
VPN网关类型。取值：
Normal（默认值）：普通型。
<props="china">- NationalStandard：国密型。</props>
parameters.name: vpn_type

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the value, but you must make sure that the value is unique among different requests. The client token can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId of each API request is unique
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
The network type of the VPN gateway. Valid values:

public (default): Internet-public VPN gateway.
private: internal-public VPN gateway
parameters.help_zh:
VPN网关的网络类型。取值：

public（默认值）：公网VPN网关。
private：私网VPN网关
parameters.name: network_type

parameters.help_en:
Specifies the second vSwitch instance to associate with the VPN gateway instance.

This parameter is required if the current region supports creating IPsec-VPN connections in the dual-tunnel pattern.
You must specify two vSwitch instances distributed in different zones under the VPC to which the VPN gateway instance is associated, to implement zone-level disaster recovery for the IPsec-VPN connection.
For regions that support only one zone, zone-level disaster recovery is not supported. We recommend that you specify two different vSwitch instances in the zone to implement high availability for the IPsec-VPN connection. You can specify the same vSwitch instance.

For more information about the regions and zones that support dual-tunnel IPsec-VPN connections, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2358946.html
parameters.help_zh:
指定VPN网关实例关联的第二个交换机实例。

如果当前地域支持创建双隧道模式的IPsec-VPN连接，则本参数必填。
您需要从VPN网关实例关联的VPC实例下指定两个分布在不同可用区的交换机实例，以实现IPsec-VPN连接可用区级别的容灾。
对于仅支持一个可用区的地域 ，不支持可用区级别的容灾，建议您在该可用区下指定两个不同的交换机实例以实现IPsec-VPN连接的高可用，支持指定相同的交换机实例。

关于支持双隧道模式IPsec-VPN连接的地域和可用区的信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2358946.html
parameters.name: disaster_recovery_vswitch_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the resource group to which the VPN gateway belongs.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/158855.html operation to query resource group IDs.
If you do not specify this parameter, the VPN gateway belongs to the default resource group after it is created.
After the VPN gateway is created, if you create an SSL server, an SSL client certificate, an IPsec server, or an IPsec-VPN connection (referring to the scenario where the IPsec-VPN connection is associated with the VPN gateway) under the VPN gateway, these resources automatically belong to the resource group of the VPN gateway and their resource groups cannot be modified.

  If you change the resource group of the VPN gateway, the resource groups of the preceding resources are also changed
parameters.help_zh:
VPN网关所属的资源组ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/158855.html接口查询资源组ID。
如果您未指定资源组ID，VPN网关创建完成后将归属于默认资源组。
VPN网关创建完成后，如果您在VPN网关下创建SSL服务端、SSL客户端证书、IPsec服务端或IPsec连接（指IPsec连接绑定VPN网关的场景），则这些资源将直接归属在VPN网关所属的资源组下，且不支持修改。

  如果您修改了VPN网关所属的资源组，则上述资源所属的资源组也将一并被修改
parameters.name: resource_group_id
